why: rowStep: the band metric's step part, max |row-mean step| (any channel, 0-255) down the hero's bottom third and 8 CSS px into MissionBlock; BASE 16.0-17.0 on every slide (the bone->parchment seam), the golden fix simulated on BASE 2.36-4.32, so the ceiling is 4.35 (Codi: 'stays where your fix has it'). sourceBpp: the starvation part, source bytes x 8 / delivered pixels; BASE yellow 0.46-0.53, the lowest kept slide is pink at 1.38 (2048 wide) and 1.57 (1920). seam: last hero row vs first MissionBlock row, per channel. largestAt/minLargestWidth: no 2560 variant, so at 1280 DPR2 the hero must pick its largest candidate (2048w on BASE and the fix) and that must be >= 1920w (Codi). kinkBase: BASE's join kink, the pull's slope jumping 0 -> 1/72 alpha/px at 72px; kinkRatio 0.1 is Codi's limit for the top stop (the fix: 0.072); kinkInterior 0.25 bounds every other joint at or above kinkZone px (the fix: 0.234 at 72px, from 8-bit alpha steps; Codi's own 16px joint, below the zone, is 0.34); profileTol: the rendered pull over black vs parchment x alpha(y), BASE <= 2.09 levels, the fix <= 2.34 (preview DPR2), bottom profileSkip px excluded. Calibration numbers: goldens/f1-calibration.json.
